items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: He learned to play like Johnny Dodds. ... They don't understand the greatness of Johnny Dodds.

ctx.x: He learned to play like Johnny Dodds. People still do not understand, especially a critic who -- I try to use that word kindly, but it's very hard. But they
don't understand. They don't understand the greatness of Johnny Dodds. Because, again, they take him out of context. They listen with deafened ears, they can't listen with ears all the time.
